description: Update an existing feedback record by ID. Returns the updated status and feedback IDs, changes only value, weight, and metadata, and leaves the trace linkage immutable; use create_feedback only for a new record.

id.description: The unique identifier of the feedback to update

metadata.description: New or updated custom metadata for the feedback

value.description: New feedback value/rating. Common patterns: 1 for positive, 0 for negative.

weight.description: New weighting factor for the feedback

name: update_feedback

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
